name: How can I tell if I have a burst pipe in my wall or underground?

mainEntity.name: How can I tell if I have a burst pipe in my wall or underground?

acceptedAnswer.text: Signs of a hidden burst pipe include a sudden, unexplained drop in water pressure, discolored water, the sound of running water when no faucets are on, or a significant increase in your water bill. For pipes inside walls, you might notice damp spots, water stains, bulging drywall, or a musty odor. For underground pipes, look for unusually wet spots in your yard, muddy areas, sinkholes, or reduced water flow to your home. If you suspect a hidden leak, Alpha-Plumbing Services uses specialized equipment to accurately detect the source without unnecessary damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for unexplained water pressure drops, discolored water, sounds of running water, increased water bills, damp spots, or wet areas in your yard. Alpha-Plumbing Services can detect hidden leaks.
